name: retreat-obstacle
title: Retreat from an obstacle
description: Back the base straight away from a piece of furniture, appliance or object until it is at least the given distance away; a held load stays held.
use_when: The base is too close to open a door, turn, or start a path.

not_to_be_confused_with.navigate: retreat has no destination; it only increases clearance.

distance_m.description: Required clearance from the obstacle footprint.

postconditions.name: base_clear_of
postconditions.meaning: Base centre at least the given distance from the place's footprint.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: base_clear_of
checks.meaning: Base centre at least the given distance from the place's footprint.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_paths.note: The microwave's measured hinge-clearance pose (also when loaded).
Straight reverse with the right-hand load.

next.when: the robot must leave after backing out
a door's swing needs room in front of the robot

fallback_for.when: navigation fails because the base or load is wedged against furniture
the door swing hits the base
the door swing hits the base

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
typical: the path behind the base is blocked
